name: agent-edit
description: An AI-native video editor: describe the edit, review the agent's proposal as real timeline operations, and keep the final say.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @agent-edit/api" "npm run dev -w @agent-edit/worker" "npm run dev -w @agent-edit/web"
scripts.test:e2e: node e2e/walkthrough.mjs && node --env-file-if-exists=.env e2e/media.mjs && node e2e/editor.mjs && node --env-file-if-exists=.env e2e/agent.mjs && node --env-file-if-exists=.env e2e/render.mjs && node --env-file-if-exists=.env e2e/start.mjs
